messages:
Riley: Quick flag - weekly KPI shows webinar signups up 40% overnight but demo invites unchanged. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/webinars/q2-launch
Sam: that's a big top-of-funnel bump. any idea which channels drove it?
Harper: ran a quick cohort pull. partner_referral and organic social are the main uplifts. partner_referral has 3x signups but demo-invite rate falls from 2.8% -> 0.6%.
Diego: could be attribution mismatch or the registration flow losing the demo-intent checkbox. did we ship any registration changes last 48h?
Riley: small update to the embed widget on Mar 25 to support country prefill. It shouldn't touch the demo checkbox but maybe the prefill script overwrote some fields.
Harper: SQL sample I ran:

```
SELECT acquisition_channel, widget_version, count(*) AS signups, sum(demo_invite::int) AS invites
FROM events.webinar_registrations
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-24' AND campaign = 'q2-launch'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY signups DESC;
```

Harper: results: partner_x, widget_v3 -> 4,120 signups, invites 25 (0.61%); organic, widget_v2 -> 1,420 signups, invites 40 (2.8%).
Sam: widget_v3 stands out. Diego, can you triage whether prefill logic sets demo_opt_in=false or clears the checkbox value on submit?
Diego: will check logs and the widget commit. Quick grep shows the prefill script writes to `form.fields.phone` and `form.fields.country` but there's a line `if (!prefill.demo) form.fields.demo = false` that looks suspicious.
Riley: that looks like it could force demo_opt_out when demo isn't included in prefill. rough fix: change to only set demo if present: `if ('demo' in prefill) form.fields.demo = prefill.demo`.
Harper: agree. short-term mitigation: add a server-side rule to mark demo_invite=true for registrations where source is partner_x and landing_path contains "webinar" while we patch the widget.
Sam: let's be careful with server-side heuristics. Better: patch widget v3 and gatefix canary for partner_x only. Also add dashboard split by widget_version and country so we can verify recovery.
Riley: plan: (1) Diego patch widget prefill line and deploy canary to partner_x slices (diego) (2) Harper add dashboard widget_version filter and add an alert for demo_invite rate <1% for top channels (harper) (3) Sam coordinate partner communications if rollback needed (sam).
kpi-bot: Weekly KPI delta: signups +40% (7d vs prior 7d); demo_invites -4% (7d avg); note: no ingestion delay detected. Action tickets: MK-5210 (widget prefill patch), MK-5211 (dashboard filter + alert), MK-5212 (partner comms).
Diego: patch in PR: widgets/prefill#762  changing demo assignment guard. starting canary for partner_x at 3501234567 + 00:20
Harper: dashboard updated: https://dash.redwood/webinars/q2-launch?split=widget_version. adding alert threshold 1% for demo_invites on partner slices.
kpi-bot: Canary monitor: partner_x demo_invite rate for canary slice currently 1.8% at +35m. Will continue to monitor; will post final in KPI sync.
Riley: solid. if canary holds, promote patch and then run a 48h A/B to confirm LTV differences before we re-enable wider widget_v3.
Sam: adding a short note to the weekly KPI deck under 'webinar attribution & widget experiment' with owners and timelines. Meeting tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Diego: promoted to prod at 3501234580 after canary OK. monitoring logs for form submissions.
kpi-bot: Update: promotion complete. Current demo_invite rate for partner_x increased from 0.6% -> 1.9% in the following 2h. Backfill recommended for the 48h window to recalc demo_invites where appropriate.
